scope: genus-zero numerical realization only; not a universal or higher-genus coefficient
method: Exact rational Gamma 2-jets, mirror-map substitution, six Li_2 master equations, and multicover extraction in a componentwise downward-closed box. No smoothing invariant is an input.

scope_of_finiteness: The 37-candidate bound is imported from the separate common-blowup certificate. This script proves only exact arithmetic in the displayed box.
